artifacts.description: feat(kernel): helical sweep of a planar profile about an axis

acceptance_criteria: New documented trait method `Kernel::helical_sweep(&self, profile: &Self::Shape, axis: Axis, pitch: f64, turns: f64) -> Result<Self::Shape, KernelError>`. The helix is right-handed about `axis.dir` (counterclockwise seen from the tip of `axis.dir`) and advances `pitch` along `axis.dir` per turn; it starts at the profile's position. The doc comment cites the OCCT reference documentation of the calls used and the Pappus–Guldin volume rule.

`OcctKernel` implements it. Any new shim function is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` block is in `ffi` and documented; the result must pass `BRepCheck_Analyzer` and be one solid, or it is an error.

Tests (behind `occt`), axis origin (0, 0, 0), dir (0, 0, 1), profiles on the XZ plane (`Workplane` with `x_dir` (1, 0, 0), normal (0, −1, 0)), volumes within a relative 1e-3, boxes within 1e-2: rectangle x ∈ [5, 6], z ∈ [0, 0.5], pitch 2, 3 turns: volume 16.5π ≈ 51.8363; one solid; bounding box z from 0 to 6.5, x and y within [−6, 6]; 6 faces (4 helical sides and 2 end faces). triangle (5, 0), (6, 0.5), (5, 1), pitch 1.5, 2 turns: volume 32π/3 ≈ 33.5103. handedness: the rectangle with 0.25 turns has a bounding box with x ≥ −1e-2, y ≥ −1e-2, y max ≈ 6 and z max ≈ 1.0. the input profile is unchanged (still one face, same area).

Errors, each with a test and never a panic, all `InvalidInput` checked before the sweep (kernel-free tests without `occt` where possible): `pitch` or `turns` zero, negative or not finite; a zero-length or non-finite `axis.dir`; a profile that is not a single planar face, or has a hole; a profile whose plane does not contain the axis (within `PERPENDICULAR_TOLERANCE` / `LOOP_GAP_TOLERANCE`); a profile that touches or crosses the axis; a profile whose extent along the axis is ≥ `pitch` (the turns would overlap).
No new dependencies; `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
